channel.title: The Strategy Lens
channel.description: Exploring how people, teams and organisations think, perform, adapt and grow, one essay at a time. By James Chikaonda.

item.title: Leadership Is What You Leave Behind in People
item.description: Leadership is not in the title, it's in the character. On oneness, mentoring, knowing your craft, having someone's back, and the mark you leave behind.

item.title: The Thanos Complex: When You Realise You Have to Do It Yourself
item.description: The lesson, if there is one: do not delegate the vision. Delegate the execution once the vision is proven.
